about: Which color is drawn on which color, for tools/design/contrast.py. The minimums are the owner's rule of 2026-11-24 (no longer WCAG AA). Names are those of docs/spec/1-tokens.md without the 'color.' head. Every fg is checked against every name in bg. 'except' lists the themes where the owner decided to keep a pair under its minimum, and why (printed, never failing). 'where' says where the screen draws it (spec 2 and 3, ui/src/components CSS and the WebGL rgb("color.…") calls).

text.about: Body text on its ground (normal size).

weak.about: Weak text: labels, units, key hints, note names (gray.8 as text) (user:2026-11-24).

ui.about: A mark with a meaning against the color next to it (notes' frames, play head, record ring, track colors, meters, focus line, on marks).

state.about: The on color against the off color of the same mark, where color is what shows the change.

disabled.about: Text of 「使えない」 parts. They must still be readable.

fill.about: Large neighbouring fills that carry a meaning (scale lock rows). 3:1 cannot be reached here by values alone without lighting up the whole work area.

faint.about: The faintest decoration: neighbouring fills (white and black key rows, white and black keys, panels next to bands), borders of 「使えない」 parts.

line.about: Lines, borders and dividers (color.line.*, gray.6, line.thin): not checked (user:2026-11-24); printed with --all.

note.about: Shown for reference, never fails: colors told apart by hue, place, a frame or words.
